# Evidence requirements

What each obligation would need before any statement about it could be defended. Automated evidence
is never sufficient where the minimum method names human or independent review.

| OBL-002 | Parental inspection and amendment of education records                    | Demonstrated export and correction workflow against synthetic data.                             | Automated functional test plus reviewed walkthrough.                                                                    | NOT-PRODUCED           |
| OBL-003 | Protected-category survey notice and consent                              | Screening record for each instrument.                                                           | Reviewed design record.                                                                                                 | INAPPLICABLE           |

## Obligations whose evidence cannot be produced internally

- **OBL-013** District web and mobile accessibility conformance to WCAG 2.1 AA — Automated scan plus documented manual testing. Independent audit is required before any external conformance statement.
- **OBL-023** Independent security attestation expectation — Independent examination. Nothing internal substitutes.
- **OBL-027** Colorado automated decision-making watch item — Reviewed determination with legal input.
- **OBL-028** Roster and enrolment data exchange — 1EdTech certification for any conformance statement; internal mapping evidence otherwise.
- **OBL-029** Program and service data exchange with state systems — Community conformance testing for any conformance statement.
